images.alt: Take the uploaded image and preserve the existing photographic composition, golden mathematical double-exposure formulas, lighting, and subject. Add a stylish, relaxed, effortlessly casual hand-drawn overlay using thin white pen lines with a rough, slightly uneven single-stroke aesthetic. Trace only selected outer contours of the woman’s hair, face, shoulders, and silhouette, leaving generous negative space. Add a few playful arrows, dotted guide lines, sparkles, tiny hearts, simple smiling emoticon faces, and a small steaming coffee cup doodle placed naturally around the composition. Integrate handwritten white ink poetry throughout the empty spaces using a loose diary-style script. The writing should feel intimate, romantic, and thoughtful, blending the language of love with mathematics. Include short poetic fragments such as: “You are the constant my heart never stops solving for.” • “In a universe of variables, you are my only certainty.” • “Our love is the proof I never need to question.” • “You + Me = my favorite equation.” • “If love is a formula, then you’re my perfect solution.” • “My heart converges only toward you.” • “Infinity was just a number until I met you.” • “Every theorem leads me back to your smile.” • “We’re asymptotes that somehow learned to touch.” • “Your name is written between every equation.” Keep the handwriting organic, imperfect, and naturally spaced rather than arranged in blocks. Allow the doodles and text to weave gently around the glowing equations without obscuring the face. Maintain the luxurious editorial feel, cinematic golden lighting, rich blacks, sparkling mathematical atmosphere, and elegant double-exposure effect while making the overlay feel as though it was casually drawn into a personal notebook after falling in love with mathematics and someone at the same time.
